title: Smoke Style
description: Renderer-agnostic style preset for stylized smoke. Every control is normalized to 0..1 (except hueShift in degrees and colors in hex) so the same file can drive the 2D canvas renderer, the 3D raymarch renderer, or future exporters. Each renderer owns its own mapping from these values to internal units.

notes.description: Free text: references, intent, source shots.

mode.description: brush = smoke is injected once and drifts away; livingStroke = the drawn line is a persistent source held at a fixed density.

base.description: Mid tone. Light, shadow, mottle, haze and AO colors are derived from it in HSL.

hueShift.description: Degrees. Lights rotate +hueShift (warmer), shadows rotate -1.3*hueShift (cooler) and gain a minimum saturation so grey smoke still gets tinted shadows.

bands.description: Number of flat tone bands (light / mid / shadow).

silhouetteThreshold.description: Density above which a pixel is part of the graphic smoke shape. Below it only haze is drawn.

shadowThreshold.description: Occlusion toward the light above which the shadow band is used.

lightDirection.description: Direction TOWARD the light, y up. 2D renderers ignore z.

amount.description: Strength of the flow-advected brush texture on edges and band boundaries.

mottle.description: Tint parts of mid and shadow bands toward two hue-rotated side colors (+38 and -48 degrees).

rise.description: Buoyancy. 2D: acceleration 0.008*rise per frame with drag. 3D: rise speed 1.0*rise voxels per frame.

curl.description: Swirl strength. 2D: vorticity confinement 0.4*curl. 3D: curl-noise gain.

dissipation.description: How fast aged smoke fades. Extra per-frame decay = 0.025*dissipation, ramped in over agingFrames.

agingFrames.description: Frames after leaving the source before age-based fading reaches full strength.

solidity.description: Blend toward blurred density for the silhouette (like EmberGen smoke dilate). Higher = fuller, simpler shapes.

ageTint.description: Fresh smoke warmer and lighter, old smoke cooler and greyer.

ambientOcclusion.description: Darken crevices where local density is below its neighborhood average.

emberCore.description: Glowing veins and red-brown shadows in fresh, dense smoke.

matchSmoke.description: Use the smoke palette instead of fixed hot / orange / dark red.
